diagnostic:
S2 implemented through the production router and green on the approved oracle: us-iis-07 21/21 scenarios and 347/347 steps (the 9 scenarios RED on the missing behaviour now pass), the whole instance-integration-setup lane 126/126 scenarios and 1479/1479 steps with no regression, foundry-app unit lane 95/95, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean, cargo xtask check-arch PASSED, cargo xtask smoke "all gates green". Commit 2c1f743.

Design followed as projected. secrets_key_rotation.rs (Extend) gains UnopenableOffer {StartOver, RestoreOnlyLiveReplica, RestoreOnly} with decide(mode, live_opener, key_file) exactly as the constructor list fixes it, plus of_gate(mode, Option<bool>, key_file) as the one owner of the unread-gate case; LiveOpeners::at(now, reload) as the D5 gate (opens_secrets_key and beat_at within three reload intervals, clock injected, never now()); SavedCredentials::start_over_question() adding the I-28 n>=2/n=1/n=0 forms through the same selector as I-23 and I-24. instance.rs (Extend) gains START_OVER_PATH, PageRead::ReplicaStates, ReadOnlyDoor::SecretsKeyStartOver reading [Snapshot, ReplicaStates], PageFacts.live_opener and the PageState fields for the appended sentence and the Start over way; page_state decides both through UnopenableOffer so no template decides anything, and the shipped SECRETS_KEY_UNOPENABLE words are only appended to. secrets_key.rs (Extend) gains the start-over GET as a ReadOnlyDoor page with I-28, I-28a and the Confirmation field in the same form as its control, and startable() reading the same offer so page and door cannot disagree. store_capabilities.rs (Extend): InstanceKeyWrites gains replica_states over the existing Store::replica_states, no new query and no row-shape change. lib.rs registers the GET only; the POST lands with S3.

Two judgements the design left to implementation, both recorded in code comments. First, KeyFile::Withheld under I-26 decides RestoreOnly: nothing is held to seal a new secrets key with (ADR-IIS-002 r3), so the way out could not work and no live server is claimed either - this is why key_file is a parameter of decide. Second, an unread replica-state list is neither a live opener nor its absence, so of_gate answers RestoreOnly: the way out is withheld and nothing false is read, rather than forcing a bool into decide.

Beyond the declared targets I extended crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/worker.rs: its RecordedSweeps test double implements InstanceKeyWrites, which the design's own Impact row requires ("every test double of it is extended"). No behaviour there changed.

Finite tables authored at the locators the S2 acceptance rows cite: the_table_of_the_three_i26_states and the_table_of_the_beats_the_gate_counts_as_a_live_opener in secrets_key_rotation.rs (L6, L7, D5 - every mode crossed with every key file and both gate readings, plus the beat ages at and past the window), the I-28 forms inside the existing L10 table and proptest, the_table_of_what_the_page_offers_while_the_stored_key_cannot_be_opened in instance.rs, and the new door in the L4/C2 reads table. No test asserts behaviour the oracle does not observe, and no oracle, support or design file was touched.

Refactors: none. No L1-L4 smell was removed and no responsibility moved, so there is no separate refactor commit.

Two gate fixes after the lanes were green, both non-behavioural: a doc list in the secrets_key.rs module doc reworded for clippy::doc_lazy_continuation, and the new instance.rs test table given a type alias for clippy::type_complexity. smoke ran the unit tests again after both.
